This container add-on takes about an hour to set up, with the data hungry offenders assigned to their individual little jails they can't break out of. That's how you can stay logged in to service X in the browser without much hassle while also browsing to service Y and both not seeing the login cookies from the other - and the general web public sites not seeing either of those.

If you open a Google service, it will use the Google container, but the Google container has no history other than the Google services.
